etherfi_ev.label: weETH (ether.fi), queue and NAV from events

no_delay.note: the own-print baselines differ by about $4: queue_live resolves requests pending at the study's end with later queue events (waits of 63 stETH, 10 weETH and 10 rsETH sales in the last days); with its waits swapped into these envs the own-print value is queue_live's, and every later-priced value is identical

hourly_taker.closer_reading: the first trade inside the later window
hourly_taker.rule: bought at the next hour boundary H, priced over [H, H+1h); the venue median of the trades inside the later window (strict: no carry-forward)

parameters.warm_start: sells before the common window are simulated too (as in the 2026-10-10 run): capital they lock at the window start is unavailable, their value is not counted
